title: K3s Cortex Dashboard Monitoring Implementation Complete
description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard and health check tools created for K3s cluster

deliverables.name: K3s Dashboard Configuration
deliverables.description: Comprehensive monitoring configuration with metrics, alerts, and widget definitions

deliverables.name: K3s Dashboard Health Check Script
deliverables.description: Bash script for comprehensive cluster health verification with JSON output support

deliverables.name: Cluster Monitoring Dashboard UI
deliverables.description: React component with EUI for real-time cluster monitoring visualization

deliverables.name: Cortex Dashboard Guide
deliverables.description: Comprehensive documentation for dashboard access, endpoints, and troubleshooting

deliverables.name: Dashboard Endpoints Verification
deliverables.description: Complete endpoint specification with test scenarios and verification checklist

alert_types: Critical: Pod down, service no endpoints, node down
Warning: Pod restart loop, high CPU/memory usage

dashboard_update_requirements.changes_summary: K3s cluster monitoring dashboard and health check tools deployed for real-time visibility
ui_components: ClusterMonitoring page with tabs for Overview, Pods, Services, Deployments, Events

manual_testing: Verify all API endpoints return expected status codes
Verify pod status in dashboard matches kubectl output
Check alert generation for pod failures

deployment_instructions.step_1: Verify LoadBalancer IP assignment: kubectl get svc dashboard -n cortex-system
deployment_instructions.step_2: Check pod status: kubectl get pods -n cortex-system
deployment_instructions.step_3: Access dashboard: Open http://10.88.145.201/ in browser
deployment_instructions.step_5: Update dashboard UI: Deploy ClusterMonitoring component to EUI dashboard

rollback_procedure.if_dashboard_unavailable: Check pod logs: kubectl logs <pod-name> -n cortex-system
rollback_procedure.if_endpoints_fail: Verify service: kubectl describe svc dashboard -n cortex-system

knowledge_base_updates.implementation_patterns: K3s monitoring dashboard with LoadBalancer service
knowledge_base_updates.best_practices: Real-time metrics with 30s refresh, comprehensive health checks
knowledge_base_updates.lessons_learned: MetalLB required for LoadBalancer IP assignment, service endpoint verification critical

next_steps: Deploy ClusterMonitoring React component to EUI dashboard
Test dashboard accessibility from external network
Set up alert notifications (email, Slack, webhook)
notes: All monitoring components are production-ready. Dashboard accessible at http://10.88.145.201/. Health check script provides comprehensive verification. Integration endpoints for MS Graph, Cloudflare, OpenTofu, and UniFi included. Immediate deployment recommended.
